about: The Workbench icons of the Speedy drawer: python3 tools/make_installer.py AMICRADLE writes them with DalsinAI/amicradle scripts/port_icons.py. The art (art/speedy.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/speedy.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. The badge is Speedy's life icon (Speedy the Rollerskater images/life_icon2.png, 336,24 24x24).
